run_eval_color: run the eval_color evaluation script on a trained meta-OT experiment directory with a given pickle tag
run_Workspace_run: run the Workspace to plot training objectives and finetune validation image pairs using meta-initialized transport
run_Workspace_finetune_val: run finetune validation comparing vanilla and meta-initialized Wasserstein GAN transport on image pairs
run_Workspace_vis_embeddings: run t-SNE visualization of pretrained ResNet18 and meta-learned embeddings for color transfer images
run_Workspace_plot_train_objs: run plotting of the dual objective training curve from the experiment log CSV file
